title: Run additional bounded result recovery batches on the operating database

source.execution_instruction: Owner answer 'Yes, bounded batches' in this session to the question whether to run more bounded recovery batches on operating after PR #236 merged

authorizes: bounded RESULT_RECOVERY runs of at most 8 UTC dates per provider each, stopping on unexplained integrity changes, more than 20 API-Football requests in total, or two consecutive runs that recover nothing
row-hash and P02 preservation comparisons before and after
requires: no request for a confirmed out-of-plan API-Football date
explicitly_not_authorized: identity admissions, fixture merges or reviewed prediction bindings
deleting rehearsal databases or operating data
supersession: Extends AUTHORIZE_PRE_P03_OPERATING_ROLLOUT_V1, which allowed one bounded batch; all its other terms stay in force.
